source.check: returned unopposed: no contest in the division (Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 6 May 1939, p. 2); named as a sitting member of the new council early in the term (Ballymena Observer, 9 June 1939, p. 10: 'On the motion of Mr. Cumming, seconded by Mr. Houston, Messrs. James A. Gaston and Robert Gregg were unanimously co-opted')

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, June 1939 (statutory day Thursday 1 June 1939): no contest. The Ballymena Observer of 5 May 1939, p. 10, lists the twelve divisions with one nomination, all 'old members of the Council', and the eleven in which 'the following retiring members were deemed re-elected'. Twenty divisions are corroborated by the council's meetings of June-September 1939 (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026); Ballyscullion, Drumanaway and Newtowncrommelin are taken from the deemed list. No party labels are printed. division inferred from the 1 June 1933 return (Thomas Cumming; Ballymena Observer, 5 May 1933, p. 10); the Ballymena Observer, 9 June 1939, p. 10 names the member as sitting for the new council (annual (first) meeting of the new Ballymena Rural Council, Wednesday 7 June 1939: members present, chairman, co-options, committees). Returned unopposed.
